core.system_default.description: Language option that follows the television

core.duration_hours.description: The one duration (length of a film or episode) in hours and minutes, on every screen that tells one: captions, hero, About, Info card, HUD, source list.

core.duration_minutes.description: The one duration under an hour, in minutes. See core.duration_hours.

core.time_left_hours.description: Time remaining on a started title, in the one duration form (core.duration_hours) plus 'left': 1h 2m left. Continue Watching captions.

core.time_left_minutes.description: Time remaining under an hour, in the one duration form (core.duration_minutes) plus 'left': 8m left. Continue Watching captions.

core.preview_fault.description: Heading in consent technical report preview

core.preview_panic.description: Heading in consent technical report preview

core.preview_domains.description: Heading in consent technical report preview

core.preview_domain_line.description: One line of the consent preview's list of possible values: a field name, then its possible technical codes.

core.preview_domain_failure_kind.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values.

core.preview_domain_delivery.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: how the video was delivered.

core.preview_domain_refusal_codes.value: server decision codes, general and transcode (refused-plan reports only)
core.preview_domain_refusal_codes.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: the numeric verdict codes the media server gave when it refused to play or convert an item. Only reports about a refusal carry it.

core.preview_domain_attempted_delivery.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: which way of delivering the video the app was opening when the failure happened, which after a mid-playback quality switch can differ from the delivery before the switch. For a refused plan it is the way the app asked the server for before the server refused.

core.preview_domain_source_video.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: the video format class of the file the server refused. Only reports about a refusal carry it.

core.preview_domain_source_audio.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: the audio format class of the file the server refused. Only reports about a refusal carry it.

core.preview_domain_quality.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values.

core.preview_domain_observed_rate.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: the measured bitrate class.

core.preview_domain_raster.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: the picture size class.

core.preview_domain_pipeline.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: the playback pipeline stage.

core.preview_domain_pipeline_error.value: TV firmware error number (0 = none recorded)
core.preview_domain_pipeline_error.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: the whole number the television's own video pipeline reported with its first error, or 0 when it reported none. Its possible values are a range of integers rather than a list of codes.

core.preview_domain_attempt_started.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: whether the attempt that failed (the latest opening of the video, such as after a quality switch) had put a picture on screen before it failed, as against the playback as a whole. Its possible values are yes and no.

core.preview_domain_attempt_origin.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: what led to the attempt that failed, such as the first press of Play, a Retry, a quality change the viewer made, a switch the app made on its own, a recovery after a failed attempt, reopening after the app returned to the foreground, or the trailer that plays behind a detail page.

core.preview_domain_attempt_ordinal.value: which attempt of this playback (1 to 9, then 9+)
core.preview_domain_attempt_ordinal.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: how many times the video had been opened during this playback, counting the failed attempt, every Retry and every switch. Its possible values are the numbers 1 to 9 and then 9+.

core.preview_domain_http_status.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: the exact HTTP status number the media server answered with, from 100 to 599, or 0 when none was recorded. Its possible values are a range of integers rather than a list of codes.

core.preview_domain_http.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: the HTTP status class.

core.preview_domain_buffer.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: the buffered time class.

core.preview_domain_transport.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: the class of network error that ended the media transfer.

core.preview_domain_transfer_age.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: how long the media transfer had been running when it failed, as a time class.

core.preview_domain_demux_exit.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: which step of reading the media stream raised the failure, as a fixed code.

core.preview_domain_elapsed.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: time since an event.

core.preview_domain_hls_direction.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: whether streaming quality went up or down.

core.preview_domain_delivery_reason.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values.

core.preview_domain_original_phase.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: the stage of an original-quality attempt.

core.preview_domain_original_outcome.description: Field name in the consent preview's list of possible playback-error values: the result of an original-quality attempt.

core.percent.description: A percentage. es and be put a no-break space before the percent sign.

core.unit_b.description: A size in bytes, abbreviated (B), for compact technical read-outs.
